lines.text: Israel is told to obey the statutes to live, and the LORD destroyed all who followed Baal of Peor.
At Sinai, the LORD spoke to Israel out of the fire and wrote the Ten Commandments on stone tablets.
Israel is warned not to make an idol of any form or bow down to the sun, moon and stars.
The LORD brought Israel out of the iron furnace of Babylon, but their leader would not cross the Jordan.
If Israel makes an idol, the LORD will scatter them among the peoples, and only a few will survive.
